blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Somānanda returns from the philosophical grave carrying an alphabet that is simultaneously transformed and untransformed. Abhinavagupta explains why the Supreme can move without travelling anywhere, introduces a wave that doesn't need an ocean outside consciousness, invokes the mysterious belly of a fish, and then subjects four tiny Sanskrit verses to such aggressive grammatical cross-examination that the entire cosmos turns out to have several legitimate meanings.

blocks.text: Now we can finally answer the question that began this installment.
blocks.directed: Now we can finally answer the question that began this installment.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: How can the supreme consciousness move if there is nowhere outside it?
blocks.directed: How can the supreme consciousness move if there is nowhere outside it?

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: The difficulty arises because we ordinarily understand movement through space.
blocks.directed: The difficulty arises because we ordinarily understand movement through space.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: But the supreme consciousness of Trika isn't one object situated inside an independently existing space.
blocks.directed: But the supreme consciousness of Trika isn't one object situated inside an independently existing space.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: It is the ultimate ground through which spatial differentiation itself becomes manifest.
blocks.directed: It is the ultimate ground through which spatial differentiation itself becomes manifest.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: Therefore ordinary displacement cannot define its dynamism.
blocks.directed: Therefore ordinary displacement cannot define its dynamism.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: And yet, Abhinavagupta refuses to treat supreme consciousness as an inert blank.
blocks.directed: And yet, Abhinavagupta refuses to treat supreme consciousness as an inert blank.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: And that power is expressed through Spanda.
blocks.directed: And that power is expressed through Spanda.

blocks.text: Not a journey from one independent substance into another.

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: The marvellous movement of consciousness within its own nature.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere

blocks.text: The same principle governs the entire Sanskrit alphabet.
blocks.directed: The same principle governs the entire Sanskrit alphabet.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: The divine Mātṛkā can be described as transformed.

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: Because her supreme conscious ground doesn't become divided into independent ultimate substances.

blocks.text: The root Tantra can describe an ordered phonemic sequence.

blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta can interpret the swallowing of that sequence.

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere

blocks.text: The power of manifestation isn't forced upon Śiva by an external cause.

blocks.text: It belongs to his own conscious nature.

blocks.text: Change in what appears need not be described as the spatial relocation of awareness itself.

blocks.text: And that is why the doctrine can be both philosophically rigorous and contemplatively interesting.

blocks.text: It asks us to examine not merely what appears, but the conscious reality through which appearing is possible.

blocks.text: All are attempts to illuminate that extraordinary dynamism.

blocks.text: And at the deepest level, the conscious ground hasn't gone anywhere.

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: Spanda is not the Absolute travelling to become something else. It is the freedom through which the Absolute manifests its own possibilities without ceasing to be itself.
blocks.directed: Spanda is not the Absolute travelling to become something else. It is the freedom through which the Absolute manifests its own possibilities without ceasing to be itself.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: That's the heart of Part XXII.
blocks.directed: That's the heart of Part XXII.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: And now the text reaches a darker question.
blocks.directed: And now the text reaches a darker question.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: If the same pure phonemic powers are present throughout consciousness, how do they become associated with limited cognition?
blocks.directed: If the same pure phonemic powers are present throughout consciousness, how do they become associated with limited cognition?

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: How does the sound-body of divine freedom become the basis of error?

23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: And how does the very capacity for meaningful words become implicated in misrecognition?
blocks.directed: And how does the very capacity for meaningful words become implicated in misrecognition?

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: The pure alphabet becomes entangled with Māyā.
blocks.directed: The pure alphabet becomes entangled with Māyā.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: The Goddess has not lost her power.
blocks.directed: The Goddess has not lost her power.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: But the finite knower no longer recognizes the fullness of its source.
blocks.directed: But the finite knower no longer recognizes the fullness of its source.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta is about to explain that concealment through the classical categories of cognition, including the extraordinary claim that no determinate cognition arises without the penetration of speech.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta is about to explain that concealment through the classical categories of cognition, including the extraordinary claim that no determinate cognition arises without the penetration of speech.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: The alphabet is about to become bondage.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The movement never needed somewhere
blocks.text: And then, perhaps, the means of recognizing freedom again.
